_comment: Sweep budget for scripts/doc_cite_adjacency.py, opened 2026-09-01. Each key is a cite whose line does not land within +/-3 of any symbol its own sentence names. The gate is red on any failure NOT here AND on any key here that has stopped failing - a waiver may not outlive its rot. Burn this down; do not grow it. Baselining is the LAST resort: 47 of the 113 failures measured on 2026-09-01 were re-anchored by hand in the same commit, and only what could not be re-anchored mechanically is here. Not every entry is rot - the reason says which are the probe's own blind spots (paired cites, docstring ranges, table rows), and those are the rows to answer with a better rule rather than a new number. AMENDED 2026-09-02 by the residuals wave: the probe now reads bare `:N` continuation cites and applies an occurrence ceiling to subjects, which re-shuffled this file. 14 cites were re-anchored to their symbol in the same commit and 2 stale waivers deleted; every entry added on 2026-09-02 was read one by one, and its reason says whether the doc is wrong or the probe cannot read the sentence.
